what: Every flow of the connection-grouped held-out test split: the two-stage model's predicted class, its confidence (the reject knob's input), whether Stage 1 escalated it to Stage 2, P(benign), and the true class. The model is the one `make train` retrains deterministically from the committed code; no model file is committed. The demo page applies the knob to these rows; tests/test_demo_data.py rebuilds the committed curve, binary PR-AUC and per-family confusion from them, and `scripts/demo_data.py --verify` regenerates this file in CI.
